name: Model Price Watch API
description: Read-only JSON feeds behind modelpricewatch.com. Every price traces to the provider's official pricing page and is re-verified on a schedule. Free to use and cite with attribution; no key required at the free tier. Prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens unless stated otherwise.
